one_line: A case study applying an ISO 50001 energy management baseline at Kuwait Oil Company across upstream oil & gas process units (gathering center, booster station gas compression, effluent water disposal plant) and two office buildings — not petroleum refining or any registered Corpus B continuous-production sector.
